presets.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
presets.summary: Build, validate, deploy, and monitor machine-learning systems that turn data and research into reliable product capabilities.
presets.description:
Required Qualifications
- Proficiency in Python and machine learning for developing practical models.
- Experience evaluating models through feature engineering, validation, statistics, or experimental evaluation.
- Ability to prepare structured or unstructured datasets using SQL, ETL, or data pipelines.
- Experience delivering models through deployment, APIs, MLOps, monitoring, or reproducible workflows.
- Clear technical communication and collaboration with technical or product teams.
- Disciplined use of version control with Git.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
- Evidence of an applied AI specialization such as natural language processing, computer vision, or generative AI.
- Familiarity with production infrastructure such as a cloud platform, Docker, or Kubernetes.
- Experience translating research papers into production systems.

sources.name: O*NET Computer and Information Research Scientists

presets.title: Computer Scientist
presets.summary: Analyze complex computing problems and design, test, and communicate rigorous software, systems, or research solutions.
presets.description:
Required Qualifications
- Strong knowledge of algorithms, data structures, programming, and mathematical modeling.
- Ability to analyze technical problems and design software or computer systems that address them.
- Experience with Python, C++, or Java and disciplined use of testing and version control.
- Understanding of operating systems, databases, computer networks, and computer architecture.
- Ability to evaluate technical feasibility, document findings, and communicate with technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with distributed systems, parallel computing, robotics, or human-computer interaction.
- Evidence of research, technical publications, prototypes, or multidisciplinary project work.
- Familiarity with statistics and experimental design.

sources.name: O*NET Computer and Information Research Scientists

presets.title: Software Engineer
presets.summary: Design, implement, test, document, and maintain dependable software in collaboration with users and engineering teams.
presets.description:
Required Qualifications
- Proficiency in software development using a language such as Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
- Experience analyzing user needs, defining requirements, and applying software design and system design principles.
- Ability to build and integrate REST APIs, databases, and maintainable application components.
- Strong testing, debugging, code review, and version control practices.
- Experience documenting software and collaborating in an Agile engineering team.

Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with distributed systems, performance optimization, or application security.
- Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.

sources.name: BLS Software Developers, Quality Assurance Analysts, and Testers

presets.title: Data Scientist
presets.summary: Transform structured and unstructured data into validated models, visual analysis, and decisions stakeholders can act on.
presets.description:
Required Qualifications
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, pandas, and NumPy for data preparation and analysis.
- Experience with statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modeling, and feature engineering.
- Ability to test and validate models and explain their assumptions, accuracy, and limitations.
- Experience visualizing findings with tools such as matplotlib, Tableau, or Power BI.
- Ability to present data-driven recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with scikit-learn, XGBoost, natural language processing, or deep learning.
- Familiarity with Spark, ETL pipelines, experiment design, and model deployment.
- Experience working with large structured and unstructured datasets.

presets.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
presets.summary: Protect systems and information by assessing risk, monitoring threats, managing vulnerabilities, and responding to incidents.
presets.description:
Required Qualifications
- Experience with security monitoring, risk assessment, vulnerability management, and incident response.
- Knowledge of network security, firewalls, access control, authentication, and encryption.
- Ability to analyze alerts and logs using SIEM tools such as Splunk and document investigation findings.
- Working knowledge of Linux, computer networks, and scripting with Python or PowerShell.
- Ability to recommend safeguards, support security awareness, and communicate risk to stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NICE Framework, MITRE ATT&CK, or related security frameworks.
- Experience with cloud security on AWS, Azure, or GCP and tools such as Nessus.
- Knowledge of threat intelligence, digital forensics, or penetration testing.

sources.name: NIST NICE Workforce Framework for Cybersecurity
sources.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
